regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focuses on speed with minimal seed specificity, using shorter k and lower cap for faster processing, while keeping early_exit and frc to balance accuracy.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Balances speed and accuracy with moderate seed specificity, using a mid-range k and cap, and allowing more flexibility in gap handling for robustness.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Prioritizes accuracy with more specific seeds and higher cap, using longer k and more conservative gap parameters to capture complex alignments.
